english.title: AATF operator/approved exporter fail to keep and make available record to enable completion of report

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an

(A)_[operator of an AATF,]_
(B)_[approved exporter,]_

failed to keep

(C)_[a record]_
(D)_[records]_

that enabled the completion of a report referred to in regulation

(E)_[66(1)]_
(F)_[66(2)]_

(G)_[record was]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 67(2), 90(7)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
